data.long_description:
Presented by Provident Properties, this exceptional 3-bedroom apartment is situated in Palace Residences 2 at Dubai Hills Estate one of the community’s most prestigious branded developments.

Unit Details:

3 bedrooms plus maid’s room
3 bathrooms
Size: 1,545 sq ft
Corner unit on a high floor
Expansive balconies with full park and pool views
Open-plan living and fully equipped kitchen
Walk-in wardrobe
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Valet parking
Two dedicated parking spaces
Unfurnished
Off-plan resale with a remaining 40% payment plan
Expected handover: Sept. 2027
Features & Amenities:

Direct access to Dubai Hills Park and Dubai Hills Mall
Indoor and outdoor state-of-the-art gyms
Outdoor lounge areas
Multiple BBQ zones and flexible lawn spaces
Children’s play area
Basement parking
24-hour security
Nearby Attractions:

Dubai Hills Mall
Dubai Hills Park
Dubai Hills Golf Club
Dubai Hills Business Park
Leading healthcare and educational facilities
Dubai Hills Estate is a master-planned community known for its lush green spaces, championship golf course, and stunning views of the Dubai skyline, Burj Al Arab and Burj Khalifa.

Why Choose This Property:
A spacious, high-floor corner unit in a prime location, perfect for buyers seeking elevated living or those who missed the original launch opportunity.
